name: Fog Cloud

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: 20-foot-radius sphere creates Heavy Obscurement; source duration/concentration and strong-wind dispersion; higher slots add 20-foot radius.

rules.text: You create a 20-foot-radius Sphere of fog centered on a point within range.
It lasts for the duration or until a strong wind (such as one created by Gust of Wind ) disperses it.
The fog’s radius increases by 20 feet for each spell slot level above 1.
